title: Book Three · Chapter 38: The Night Before
story:
On Friday, Anna takes an easy run with her friend.

Ronan watches the last part from the path. She finishes without a sharp burst of speed. Then the girls walk together and drink.

At the bench, Anna puts her bottle into her bag.

“Tomorrow,” she says.

“Eleven,” Ronan answers.

“I know the time.”

“I'm telling myself.”

She smiles. Then she looks toward the field entrance.

“I may be quiet before it starts. I get like that.”

“You don't have to talk.”

“Good. You can bring the loud voice for afterward.”

Ronan nods. He wants to say he will be there for the first lap. The words are ready in his mouth, but he leaves them there.

“I will come as soon as I can,” he says.

Anna puts a hand briefly on his sleeve.

“I know.”

Then her friend calls from the path. Anna picks up her bag and follows her toward the stairs.

At home, Ronan checks the road from the green door. He can ride on the quiet streets, but he must push at the busy corner.

He leaves the blue bike near the yard gate. Its tyres feel firm. His water bottle is clean and full.

Mum puts her customer's coat in a large bag. She needs to leave at a quarter to ten. Dad will go to Mr Sun's place at his usual time.

“The kitchen wall,” Mum reminds Ronan.

“For the rice. I know.”

“The man has the right address. He knows the green door.”

“You don't need to pay at the door,” Mum adds. “I paid at the shop.”

She shows him the small receipt. One bag. Their address is below it. Ronan reads it and leaves it on the table near the door.

Ronan looks at the empty space by the wall. There is room for the bag. He moves a small basket out of the way.

At dinner, he asks Dad about the back street.

“Is it quicker for the bike?”

Dad thinks. “The quiet part is. At the crossing, use the usual corner.”

“I will.”

Mum looks at his full bottle.

“You aren't in the run.”

“Watching is thirsty work.”

Dad smiles. He takes another piece of egg.

After the meal, Ronan puts his school work away. He lays out a clean shirt and leaves his shoes beside the chair.

There is nothing else he can do tonight. The rice man still has his other stops. Anna still has four laps in the morning.

Ronan sits outside for a few minutes. Beyond the gate, a cart passes slowly. Then the lane is quiet again.

He touches the old bell, but he does not ring it. He goes inside and puts the water bottle beside his shoes.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

burst of speed＝突然加速；briefly＝短暂地；quarter to ten＝九点四十五分；tyre＝轮胎。

## 理解问题

1. Ronan有没有重新答应一定在第一圈前到场？Anna怎样回应他的解释？
2. 他为第二天做了哪些实际准备？为什么仍不能确定到场时间？

## 读句子

**Its tyres feel firm.**

拆开看：Its tyres / feel / firm.

车的轮胎／摸起来／充实坚挺。
